question: Do the adopted research adapters reproduce and clarify the frozen real TRAIN/embargoed VALIDATION evidence without changing QuantRabbit financial truth or strategy selection?

split.purge: TRAIN labels must close before VALIDATION start minus embargo
split.mapie_inner_split: chronological 60/40 inside outer TRAIN; fit labels purged before conformal start minus one hour

truth_boundary.financial_oracle: OANDA actual realized P/L with actual spread and fill slippage implicit and financing explicit
truth_boundary.feature_source: Dukascopy official bid/ask tick-derived completed M5 features only
truth_boundary.margin: incomplete decision-time cross-currency conversion remains an admission blocker

adapter_contracts.xarray: Reindex the canonical real long table by named dimensions; populated values must be exact and absent/null cells must remain NaN.
adapter_contracts.salib: Compute fixed-seed TRAIN-only delta sensitivity on available causal Dukascopy features; VALIDATION may assess the frozen ranking but may not change it.
adapter_contracts.pymoo: Recompute constrained and diagnostic nondominated fronts for already-frozen candidate policies; no scalar objective and no validation-driven policy change.
adapter_contracts.mapie: Fit and conformalize only within outer TRAIN, then measure interval coverage on VALIDATION; missing price features are excluded, never zero-filled.

acceptance.adapter_numeric_parity: exact where algorithms are equivalent; otherwise explicit numeric/rank difference
acceptance.strategy_profitability: no adapter is credited with incremental profit unless a separately preregistered TRAIN-fixed trading rule beats ALL_TRADES on VALIDATION with paired LCB above zero
